role: Declares the opaque NBT tree type, its node kinds, builders, readers, insertion-ordered field access, the canonical text render and parse, and the tree diff implemented in nbtjson.c.

structs.name: nbt_type
structs.java: NBTBase.getId's tag kinds, in a different order (nbtbin.c maps them to Java ids)

gpu: nbt is an opaque pointer tree type; every caller that holds one holds a pointer graph
nbt_scratch_begin/nbt_scratch_end: trees built in between live in a region the end rewinds
notes: nbt_put appends without replacing (nbtedit.c and nbt_replace cover replacement). Under GCC or clang nbt_put is a macro: a key proven a string literal by __builtin_constant_p goes through nbt_put_site's per-call-site cache (checked by pointer), any other through the nbt_put function's interning.
